organization_read.name: organization_read
organization_read.using:
id = nullif(current_setting('app.organization_id', true), '')::uuid or coalesce(current_setting('app.platform', true), '') = 'on' or id in (select m.organization_id from organization_memberships m
    where m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid and m.status = 'active')

membership_read.name: membership_read
membership_read.using: organization_id = nullif(current_setting('app.organization_id', true), '')::uuid or user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid

inventory_movements_quantity_sign.name: inventory_movements_quantity_sign
inventory_movements_quantity_sign.value:
("inventory_movements"."type" = 'entry' and "inventory_movements"."quantity" > 0)
        or ("inventory_movements"."type" in ('exit', 'loss') and "inventory_movements"."quantity" < 0)
        or ("inventory_movements"."type" = 'adjustment' and "inventory_movements"."quantity" <> 0)
        or "inventory_movements"."type" = 'count'

inventory_movements_counted.name: inventory_movements_counted
inventory_movements_counted.value:
("inventory_movements"."type" = 'count') = ("inventory_movements"."counted_quantity" is not null)
        and ("inventory_movements"."counted_quantity" is null or "inventory_movements"."counted_quantity" = "inventory_movements"."balance_after")
